Container.Name: Sportarr
Container.Overview: Sportarr is a sports PVR for usenet and torrents. It monitors sports leagues and events across hundreds of sports worldwide, searches your indexers for releases, and handles downloading, file renaming, organization, and media server integration with Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby. Includes IPTV DVR recording, quality profiles with upgrades, multi-part event support for fighting sports, and notifications.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Sportarr web interface.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Media library root. Add your sports library as a root folder inside Sportarr under this mount.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the container runs as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the container runs as (100 = users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File permission mask for created files.
